During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] on<ref name="AOTC" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="aotcvis">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''patron''' sat at the bar of the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="AOTC" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> located in the world's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]]. At the bar, he looked inside of his drink and wondered what was floating in it and why whatever was in it seemed to be looking back at him.<ref name="Insider65" /> The human had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and wore beige clothing while at the club.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The club patron appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AOTC" /> portrayed by an uncredited extra during the Outlander Club scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The character was first revealed in the trailer for Episode II,<ref name="Trailer">{{SW|url=video/episode-ii-trailer-clone-war|text=Attack of the Clones Trailer: Clone War &#124; Video}}</ref> released on [[March 10]], [[2002]],<ref name="TrailerRelease">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/article/2002/03/04/sneak-peek-next-episode-ii-trailer|text=A sneak peek at the next <nowiki>''</nowiki>Episode II<nowiki>''</nowiki> trailer|author=Brown, Scott|date=2002-03-04|work=[[Wikipedia:Entertainment Weekly|''Entertainment Weekly'']]|quote=On March 10, the latest two-and-a-half-minute tease for "Attack of the Clones" will hit screens|archivedate=20231127115801}}</ref> and first appeared the film's [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook|storybook adaptation]], written by [[Sarah Hines Stephens]] and [[Jane Mason]],<ref name="Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]''</ref> and in the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]].<ref name="BH">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Both books released simultaneously on [[April 23]], 2002,<ref name="BHRelease">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref> and took images from the then upcoming film for the character.<ref name="Storybook" /><ref name="BH" /> Episode II released on [[May 16]], 2002.<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref>
